inspection_method: local git checkout; inspected README, root inventory, index.md, editing guide, .obsidian plugin tree, .gitignore, and representative contested-content notes

anchors.why: Describes the vault as an Obsidian Markdown vault deployed on the web and lists plugins/theme.
Uses dg-home and dg-publish frontmatter and exposes public project framing.
Defines public editing norms and asks contributors to use evidence/references.
Tracks Obsidian plugin JavaScript/manifests/styles/data in the repository.
Ignores Digital Garden plugin, Obsidian app state, workspace files, .env, media, and package artifacts.
Representative files show flat-earth, NASA, and conspiracy-oriented claims unsuitable for borrowing as knowledge.

known_limits: Content contains high-risk pseudoscientific and conspiracy claims.
Publication flags do not indicate review status.
Bundled plugin JavaScript creates supply-chain and repo-hygiene concerns.
External image hosts are fragile and should not count as retained evidence.
